# video2dlssnr compatibility code

`archspoof.cpp`, `archspoof.h`, and `nr_params.h` are copied without changes
from Daniil Sokolyuk's MIT-licensed video2dlssnr, commit
`9e1bbfa5a700d0cd63b224ab6d95581bfe7ec959`:
https://github.com/DaniilSokolyuk/video2dlssnr

`../common.h` supplies the small logging/string interface used by archspoof.
The original MIT license is included and installed with the Windows package.
NVIDIA driver/runtime DLLs are not included in these source files.
